summary.text: Andrew Kuzma is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 39 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he holds a law degree from Duquesne University.

paragraphs.text: Kuzma graduated from Elizabeth Forward High School in 2014, earned a B.S. in biological sciences and chemistry from the University of Pittsburgh in 2018, and received a J.D. from Duquesne University in 2021.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Kuzma defeated Richard Self in the 2022 general election for District 39, succeeding Michael Puskaric, and defeated Angela Girol in 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Game & Fisheries, Local Government (as subcommittee chair on Counties) and Professional Licensure committees.
Democrat Dylan Altemara is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
